role: Gate: replays ChunkLoadProbe recordings through chunkload.c (spawn area, login, per-tick unload, populate feed, C03 moves, save marks, view radius) and requires the engine's chunk load/populate/unload event stream to equal events.jsonl row for row.
notes: Data: out/java/chunkload/*, recorded with make script ARGS=--chunklog. Native calls: cl_init, cl_replay_load, cl_spawn_area, cl_login, cl_unload_step, cl_c03, cl_save_marks, cl_view_radius, cl_set_feed. The Java member names are the vanilla methods the event stream mirrors; not each checked against chunkload.c comments. Test code, built only into out/native/test_*; not on the product or GPU path, so no GPU hazards are listed.
